name: Zhipu Coding Usage
author: Aniakea
description: Zhipu GLM Coding Plan usage — quota windows with reset countdowns and pace projection, a 24h token chart, and day/week/month history in a themed Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar glyph and one panel: the 5-hour and weekly quota windows with reset countdowns and per-model token usage for the last 24 hours.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar shows beside the glyph: the 5-hour percent, the weekly percent, both, or nothing.

schema.label: Panel language
schema.description: Panel and notification language. Auto follows the system locale; notifications also honor a "language" value in the config file.

schema.label: Bar glyph
schema.description: Override the bar icon if your font lacks the default bolt.
